title: Deeala at Mountain Town

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Hey, it's you! Good to see you. Wait, now I've forgotten what I was doing...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, it's you! Good to see you. Wait, now I've forgotten what I was doing...

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Right.... Oh! I remember now. I was looking at my Comm and just walking around on autopilot. But this is the right district. I am looking for Reese.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right.... Oh! I remember now. I was looking at my Comm and just walking around on autopilot. But this is the right district. I am looking for Reese.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: He's the bartender at Mollyphonic and my boss Del is going to fire him if he's late for one more shift.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's the bartender at Mollyphonic and my boss Del is going to fire him if he's late for one more shift.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: At the club? The same. Mollyphonic has benefitted from the LUZ. Our patrons appreciate a bit of murder and morbid intrigue. They embrace the darkness.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At the club? The same. Mollyphonic has benefitted from the LUZ. Our patrons appreciate a bit of murder and morbid intrigue. They embrace the darkness.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You're trying a bit too hard... but I respect the enthusiasm. It's kinda adorable that you're going this hard.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're trying a bit too hard... but I respect the enthusiasm. It's kinda adorable that you're going this hard.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I mean are you into darkwave gothic synthcore with a side order of chunky platform boots, latex and black lipstick. Or are you, you know... normal. Vanilla.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean are you into darkwave gothic synthcore with a side order of chunky platform boots, latex and black lipstick. Or are you, you know... normal. Vanilla.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Looking for the right person to broaden your horizons, huh? I like it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Looking for the right person to broaden your horizons, huh? I like it.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Ah, well Mollyphonic ain't for everyone. I confess, sometimes I get kinda tired of the screaming and the... darkness. I'm partial to some jazz - when I'm in the mood, and in good company.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, well Mollyphonic ain't for everyone. I confess, sometimes I get kinda tired of the screaming and the... darkness. I'm partial to some jazz - when I'm in the mood, and in good company.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You're a wee ray of sunshine, ain't ya! You're either not even TRYING to impress me, or you know flattery and compliments don't work on me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a wee ray of sunshine, ain't ya! You're either not even TRYING to impress me, or you know flattery and compliments don't work on me.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Well... maybe if I hear about any jazz concerts I'll hook you up. There's a place called the Blue Chui. Maybe once the LUZ clears...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... maybe if I hear about any jazz concerts I'll hook you up. There's a place called the Blue Chui. Maybe once the LUZ clears...

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Well... I'll keep it in mind. Oh, wait. Fuck fuck fuck! Reese starts his shift in 15 minutes. I have to find him. Sorry to run. Catch ya later!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... I'll keep it in mind. Oh, wait. Fuck fuck fuck! Reese starts his shift in 15 minutes. I have to find him. Sorry to run. Catch ya later!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Hey, if you really are up for going to Mollyphonic some time, I could probably get you past the bouncers. Maybe even get you in for free!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, if you really are up for going to Mollyphonic some time, I could probably get you past the bouncers. Maybe even get you in for free!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Besides your clothes? Make-up. Attitude. Maybe you could have a good darkwave moniker - you know, a cool new name. Oh, and can you actually dance?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Besides your clothes? Make-up. Attitude. Maybe you could have a good darkwave moniker - you know, a cool new name. Oh, and can you actually dance?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Fair play to ya, that's honest I suppose. You can always just kinda... sway. That's what most people do anyway. Not a lot of spinning or two-step at Mollyphonic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fair play to ya, that's honest I suppose. You can always just kinda... sway. That's what most people do anyway. Not a lot of spinning or two-step at Mollyphonic.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: That's the spirit. CORA loves those who try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the spirit. CORA loves those who try.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Sure darlin'. That's good enough for me I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure darlin'. That's good enough for me I guess.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Alright, we got a plan for dancing, but what are you going to wear?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, we got a plan for dancing, but what are you going to wear?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: That's not gonna cut it darlin'. You don't have to dress like a diehard cybergoth but you can't dress like a dickhead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not gonna cut it darlin'. You don't have to dress like a diehard cybergoth but you can't dress like a dickhead.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I must say, I can't picture you in that right now, but I'm sure you could pull it off. You'd fit right in darlin'.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I must say, I can't picture you in that right now, but I'm sure you could pull it off. You'd fit right in darlin'.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You're trying. I can see that. It's a good start.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're trying. I can see that. It's a good start.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Look, I'll level with ya. You seem alright. But I don't think you're gonna fit it at my club, or with... me. I think I'd rather we were just friends.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I'll level with ya. You seem alright. But I don't think you're gonna fit it at my club, or with... me. I think I'd rather we were just friends.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: And not the kind of friends that hang out a lot. Or at all. Or talk, or laugh or who go for coffee. Just like... well wishers. In that I wish you no particular harm.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And not the kind of friends that hang out a lot. Or at all. Or talk, or laugh or who go for coffee. Just like... well wishers. In that I wish you no particular harm.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Great! Cool! See you around. Or, you know, probably not... Love ya!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great! Cool! See you around. Or, you know, probably not... Love ya!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: But you're a good sport. And good fun. We could be friends, you know? If... that was something you wanted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you're a good sport. And good fun. We could be friends, you know? If... that was something you wanted.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I dunno... You're not really my type. But who is? Let's just... see how this goes, ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I dunno... You're not really my type. But who is? Let's just... see how this goes, ok?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Right, so I guess we do... friend stuff. Chat and bitch about our jobs and stuff like that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right, so I guess we do... friend stuff. Chat and bitch about our jobs and stuff like that?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Sweet. Well, I gotta go, but I'll see you around. I'm pretty busy, what with the two jobs and my, you know, whole... vibe. But we'll catch up soon!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sweet. Well, I gotta go, but I'll see you around. I'm pretty busy, what with the two jobs and my, you know, whole... vibe. But we'll catch up soon!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: A lot of mascara and black chrome and fishnets and hairspray on the dance floor, if you know what I mean. Does that appeal to you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A lot of mascara and black chrome and fishnets and hairspray on the dance floor, if you know what I mean. Does that appeal to you?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: But we'd need to do something about your clothes. And... well there's a lot we'd need to work on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But we'd need to do something about your clothes. And... well there's a lot we'd need to work on.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Think sexy. Think transgressive. What have you always dreamed of wearing? If you knew no one would judge you, what would your ultimate outfit be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Think sexy. Think transgressive. What have you always dreamed of wearing? If you knew no one would judge you, what would your ultimate outfit be?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: That's a start ...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a start ...

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I feel you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel you!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: It'll get you there!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It'll get you there!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Hot!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hot!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Look, I'll admit, I was teasing you a little. You probably don't really want to go to Mollyphonic. You probably can't even get in anyway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I'll admit, I was teasing you a little. You probably don't really want to go to Mollyphonic. You probably can't even get in anyway.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm... good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm... good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who is Reese?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who is Reese?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How's work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How's work?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: None of that sounds appealing at all. I cannot overstate how much I do not want to be involved in any of what you just described.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: None of that sounds appealing at all. I cannot overstate how much I do not want to be involved in any of what you just described.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: None of that sounds appealing at all. I cannot overstate how much I do not want to be involved in any of what you just described.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: None of that sounds appealing at all. I cannot overstate how much I do not want to be involved in any of what you just described.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean it's not really my scene, but maybe I could explore it with the right person?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean it's not really my scene, but maybe I could explore it with the right person?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I mean it's not really my scene, but maybe I could explore it with the right person?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I mean it's not really my scene, but maybe I could explore it with the right person?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I am the darkness. My black heart beats with the rhythm of distorted industrial synthesizers, and I worship at the altar of endless night.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am the darkness. My black heart beats with the rhythm of distorted industrial synthesizers, and I worship at the altar of endless night.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I am the darkness. My black heart beats with the rhythm of distorted industrial synthesizers, and I worship at the altar of endless night.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I am the darkness. My black heart beats with the rhythm of distorted industrial synthesizers, and I worship at the altar of endless night.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.

nodes.text: I don't like jazz either.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't like jazz either.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like jazz.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like jazz.

nodes.text: Yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah.

nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.text: I cannot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I cannot.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can learn?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can learn?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I am enraptured by the dark, throbbing bass and the ambient, eternal wail of the synths as I sway to the dark rhythms of my blackened heart.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am enraptured by the dark, throbbing bass and the ambient, eternal wail of the synths as I sway to the dark rhythms of my blackened heart.
